authoring.method: Original cuboid paper/toy meshes, attached shallow fringe, original deterministic atlas, rigid skinning and authored clips.

source_concept.reference: Minecraft Creeper; recognizable paper/confetti parody. Exact lead concept inspected before construction; no private inputs.

lead_checkpoint.decision: Proceed with final packaging and animation/browser evidence; actual front/back/three-quarter clearly read as intended Creeper party-popper parody. Verify physical hat attachment; preserve four feet and continuous sash. No broader visual redesign.

final_hidden_fastening_correction.description: Two concealed glued plum tabs physically bridge torso to sash; no visible redesign. Sash intersects canister.

final_art_review.decision: Inspected final side and five-row motion grid. Visible construction matches selected parody direction, with readable puff/sneeze and intact seated defeat. Proceed to final package; no further art revision.

runtime.root_motion: No caller scene translation; root joint fixed.

defeat.name: defeat
defeat.end_behavior: Wobbles and sits down intact; terminal pose holds.

runtime.texture: One original embedded 1024px JPEG atlas; no external decoder or resources.

construction.runtime_construction: Named editable parts retained in excluded source collection; joined into one runtime skin and three opaque material primitives.

retained_iterations.reason: Actual GLB render detected default primitive UV layer; corrected before lead selection. Earlier exported sources and three images retained.
Lead-selected shape retained; two hidden glued fastening tabs subsequently added to physically connect sash and torso. All final named views/videos use the new exact GLB.

limitations: No physical iPhone/iPad Safari, device GPU performance, integrated gameplay or owner approval claim.
Confetti is six small opaque skinned paper bits; no runtime particle system or sound is embedded.
